## Homepage

**URL**: https://aisearchmastery.com/
**Title**: See How AI Sees You

AI Search Mastery provides two tools that diagnose your AI search visibility and make your website readable by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude.

### The Three-Layer AI Visibility Gap

Most businesses are invisible to AI search across three layers:

1. **Not Found** — AI models can't recommend what they can't see. If your content isn't structured for AI crawlers, you're invisible to the fastest-growing search channel.

2. **Not Cited** — Even when AI finds your content, it may not reference you. Without clear authority signals and structured claims, you're data without attribution.

3. **Not Chosen** — Being found and cited isn't enough. AI chooses the clearest, most trustworthy answer. If that's not you, a competitor gets the recommendation.

### The Amplifier Effect

AI lowers the build barrier, meaning more competitors in every market. When anyone can build, discoverability becomes the number-one determinant of who wins.

### The Framework

An open framework for AI search: 8 pillars, 27 factors, openly published. No black boxes, no secret sauce — just a clear methodology you can inspect, question, and build on.

### Built by a Practitioner

Jamie Watters built AI Search Mastery because he needed it himself. As a programmer building AI-powered products, he discovered his own tools were invisible to AI search. The MASTERY-AI framework came from solving that problem — not theory, but practice. A practitioner sharing what works — not a guru selling certainty.

## MASTERY-AI Framework

**URL**: https://aisearchmastery.com/framework
**Title**: The MASTERY-AI Framework
**Version**: 3.1.1 (Last reviewed: February 2026)
**Author**: Jamie Watters

An open methodology for AI search visibility. 8 pillars, 27 factors — and you can inspect every one. Most businesses have no idea how AI search evaluates their website. Traditional SEO metrics tell part of the story, but AI models weigh different signals. Without a clear framework, optimisation is guesswork.

### The 8 Pillars

#### M — Machine Readability (4 factors)
Can AI crawlers access your content? Machine readability is the foundation — if AI systems can't read your site, nothing else matters. This pillar evaluates your robots.txt configuration, llm.txt presence, crawl accessibility, and content structure. Businesses with strong machine readability see higher rates of AI citation because their content is actually available to be referenced.

#### A — Authority Signals (3 factors)
Does your site demonstrate genuine expertise? AI models evaluate trust signals differently from traditional search engines. This pillar measures your domain authority indicators, expertise demonstration, and trust markers. Establishing clear authority signals helps AI models confidently recommend your business over competitors.

#### S — Structured Data (3 factors)
Is your information organised for machine understanding? Schema markup, clear data structures, and semantic HTML help AI systems extract and cite your information accurately. This pillar evaluates your schema implementation, data organisation, and semantic clarity. Well-structured data means AI systems can accurately represent your business in their responses.

#### T — Technical Foundation (4 factors)
Does your site meet the technical requirements AI systems expect? Page speed, mobile responsiveness, security, and site architecture all influence how AI crawlers evaluate your site. This pillar covers performance, security posture, mobile experience, and site architecture. A strong technical foundation ensures AI systems can efficiently process your entire site.

#### E — Entity Recognition (3 factors)
Can AI systems identify your brand as a distinct entity? In a world of information overload, being recognised as a specific, trustworthy entity is critical. This pillar measures brand consistency, entity disambiguation, and knowledge graph presence. Strong entity recognition means AI models associate your brand with your area of expertise.

#### R — Reputation & Citations (3 factors)
Is your business referenced across the web? AI models triangulate information from multiple sources. If other credible sites mention and link to your business, AI systems treat you as more authoritative. This pillar evaluates external references, citation quality, and backlink health. Businesses with diverse, quality citations are more likely to be recommended by AI systems.

#### Y — Your Content Quality (4 factors)
Is your content comprehensive, current, and genuinely valuable? AI models prioritise content that thoroughly addresses user queries. This pillar measures content depth, freshness, originality, and user value alignment. High-quality content that directly answers user questions is the strongest signal for AI recommendation.

#### AI — AI-Specific Optimisation (3 factors)
Have you optimised specifically for how AI models work? Beyond traditional SEO, AI systems have unique preferences for content format, conversational relevance, and direct answer provision. This pillar evaluates AI-specific formatting, conversational readiness, and answer optimisation. AI-specific optimisation is the newest frontier — and the area where most businesses have done the least work.

### Open Methodology

We show you exactly what we measure and why. No black boxes, no proprietary secrets. The MASTERY-AI Framework is openly published so you can inspect it, question it, and build on it. This isn't about gatekeeping knowledge — it's about giving you the tools to understand AI search yourself.

**Can I cancel anytime?**
Yes. Both products are month-to-month. Cancel from your dashboard anytime — no contracts, no questions.

**How quickly will I see results?**
You'll get your LLM.txt file or AI visibility score within minutes. Improvements in AI search visibility typically appear within 2-4 weeks as AI models recrawl your site.

**What if I'm not technical?**
Both tools are designed for non-technical users. Point at your website, click a button, get results. No code required.

**What is AImpactMonitor?**
AImpactMonitor tracks how AI platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude cite your brand. It monitors citations, verifies accuracy, and tells you exactly what to fix. Coming soon — sign up for early access on our products page.

## About

**URL**: https://aisearchmastery.com/about
**Title**: Built by a Practitioner, Not a Guru
**Author**: Jamie Watters, Founder

### The Story

Jamie Watters is a systems programmer building AI-powered products as a solo founder. When he started shipping his own tools, he hit a wall: AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews were answering questions directly — and his products were invisible to them. Traditional SEO wasn't enough. He needed to understand how AI decides which businesses to recommend.

So he did what any programmer would do — he researched, tested, and built. He dug into how large language models evaluate and rank businesses. The signals AI looks for are different from traditional search: authority, structured data, sentiment, topical depth — factors that no existing tool was measuring. So he built one.

That research became the MASTERY-AI Framework — 8 pillars, 27 measurable factors that determine whether AI recommends your business or ignores it. He built the tools to solve his own problem first. Then he realised every business building online has the same problem.

### The Journey

1. Hit the AI visibility wall — Started shipping AI-powered products as a solo founder and discovered they were invisible to AI search engines — no matter how good the code was.
2. Researched how AI models evaluate and recommend businesses — Dug into the signals large language models use to decide which brands to mention: authority, structure, sentiment, and more.
3. Built the MASTERY-AI Framework — Codified the research into a repeatable, measurable system — 8 pillars, 27 factors any business can use.
4. Launched AImpactScanner — Built the first tool so businesses can see exactly how AI perceives them — and what to fix.
5. Launched LLM.txt Mastery — Created a tool that generates the structured files AI models need to understand your business.

### The Mission

Every business with genuine value is discoverable.

AI search is the biggest shift in how customers find businesses since Google launched. The companies that adapt early will thrive. The mission is to make sure that adapting doesn't require a six-figure agency contract or a team of specialists — just the right tools and the right framework.

### Values

- **Radical Transparency** — Show the methodology, the pricing, and the limitations. If it's not transparent, it's not trustworthy.
- **Practitioner-First** — Build from experience, not theory. Every feature exists because it was needed.
- **Relentless Simplicity** — If a solopreneur can't use it in 5 minutes, it's too complicated.
- **Evidence Over Opinion** — Measure, test, iterate. Claims without data are just marketing.
- **Accessible Excellence** — World-class tools shouldn't require world-class budgets.
